# MediaFlow Studio 1.2.9 — Safer, clearer, and made for your editing workflow

## ✨ New

### 🖱️ Drag a finished file straight into your editor
- When a file is **Done**, grab its row and drop it into **Premiere Pro**, **DaVinci Resolve**, After Effects or any folder: the real file comes along, not a shortcut.
- Works in the Converter, Audio Extractor, AI Enhance and Downloader.

### ✂️ Download only the part you need
- In the Downloader, click **Only a part**, type the start and end (`1:05` → `1:42`) and only that passage is downloaded, cut on the exact frame.
- The file name shows which part it is, so two passages of the same video never overwrite each other.

### 📚 Whole playlists in one click
- Paste a playlist link: MediaFlow lists every video and offers **Download all (n)**.
- The videos download **one after another**, each in the format and quality you picked, and you can remove the ones you don't want while the others wait.

### 💾 Your own presets
- In the Converter's **Advanced** mode, set your codec, container, frame rate and tracks, then click **Save** and give them a name (*Resolve DNxHR HQ*, *Client web delivery*…).
- Pick it again in one click from **My presets**.
- **Export** them as a `.json` file to share with your team, **Import** the ones you receive. Every value is checked before it is used.

## 🔒 Security

- **yt-dlp ignores outside config files.** A `yt-dlp.conf` placed in your download folder or elsewhere on the PC can no longer change what the app runs.
- **The window can't be taken elsewhere.** A dropped link or a stray click can't open a web page or a new window inside MediaFlow Studio.
- **The update source is locked.** Installed apps only take updates from the official GitHub releases. The test override now works in development builds only.
- **Presets are checked.** An imported preset file can only contain the settings and values the app knows.
- **Smaller app.** Only the languages MediaFlow speaks are shipped.

## 🛠️ Fixed

- **Audio "Copy" + "Mix" tracks** failed with an FFmpeg error. The mix is now encoded properly.
- **Cancel works from the first second.** Before, cancelling while a file was still being analysed (or while the GPU was being tested) did nothing and the job started anyway.
- **No more name clashes.** Several jobs started at the same moment could pick the same output name. Each one now reserves its own name (`name (1).mp4`, `name (2).mp4`…).
- **Downloads with the same title** (two "Intro" videos…) no longer overwrite each other: the name now includes the video's id.
- **AI Enhance refuses a video without a readable duration** with a clear message, instead of stopping after the first second.
- **Temporary files left behind by a crash** are cleaned at start-up, for downloads as well as AI jobs.
- Deleting large temporary folders no longer freezes the window, and a file still held by a closing process is retried.
- A graphics driver that hangs during the AI test no longer blocks Settings: the test stops after 30 seconds.
- **Escape** no longer cancels your whole queue when you only meant to close a drop-down list.

## 💡 Improved

### 💬 Errors you can understand
- FFmpeg and yt-dlp messages are now explained in your language: *the disk is full*, *the file is open in another app*, *this video is private*, *age-restricted*, *not available in your country*, *no connection*…
- **Settings → Open logs** opens `main.log`, with every error and the details of failed jobs, ready to share if you need help.

### 🧮 AI Enhance watches your disk
- Before it starts, AI Enhance checks there is enough free space for its temporary frames and tells you how much it needs.
- Temporary video pieces are deleted as soon as they are joined, so a long job uses much less disk.

### ♿ Easier to read and use
- Secondary text and the main blue button now meet the **WCAG AA** contrast level.
- Settings keeps the keyboard and screen readers inside the dialog while it is open.
- Screen readers announce the current tool and the state of every toggle, and no longer read out every progress update.
- In a narrow window, the bottom bar wraps onto two lines instead of squeezing its buttons.
- Error messages wrap onto several lines and stay **8 seconds** on screen, so you have time to read them.

### ⚙️ Behind the scenes
- Tests now run on every change pushed to GitHub, not only on releases.

Already on 1.2.x? The app offers this update automatically: click **Update**, then **Restart & Install**.
